title: Q2 Quarter Plan: Private Deployment Release Windows, Wave Scheduling & OKR Mapping
creator: Aisha Kapoor
description: Objective: Produce a concrete quarterly release plan for Private/VPC/on-prem deployments that maps release waves to OKRs, identifies critical dependencies, and defines gating criteria for enterprise customers. Scope: release windows (wave cadence and duration), customer cohorting rules, rollback and fallback policies (hosted fallback for partial outages), upgrade sequencing for mixed-version fleets, and cross-functional checklists (security, infra, support, docs). Out of scope: feature-level engineering tasks (those remain in ENG tickets). Deliverables: release calendar, dependency heatmap, gating checklist, support playbook, and one pilot migration with a prioritized customer. Success signals: no customer-impacting regressions in pilot wave; on-time rollout for wave 1; documented runbook and signoffs from security and support.
acceptance_criteria: Release calendar published with explicit windows for Q2 and Q3 (dates and owners)
Dependency heatmap created and validated with Eng/Infra owners for all high/medium items
Gating checklist defined and signed off by Security and Customer Success
Pilot migration runbook executed and retrospective (lessons + action items) published
Clear mapping from release waves to one or more OKRs with measurable metrics
comments: 2025-02-12 - Ticket created by Aisha. Initial ask: unify wave scheduling across regions and provide deterministic upgrade windows for enterprise customers.
2025-02-14 - sync w/Eng (Ben, Carmen). Eng suggested breaking waves by capacity class rather than customer size to reduce churn on Dedicated clusters.
2025-02-17 - Security (Diego) requested mandatory KMS migration validation and a pre-upgrade key-rotation window; added to gating checklist.
2025-02-18 - PM review (Maya). Customer Success requested a 'pilot customer' slot to validate the rollback procedure; agreed to reserve 2 slots for early adopters.

2025-02-21 - Trade-off decision: prefer 2-week waves with immediate hotfix channels rather than stretched 4-week windows to allow faster iteration and finer rollback control. Logged rationale in Confluence.
2025-02-24 - Draft heatmap uploaded; Eng flagged ENG-23111 (autoscaling hooks) and ENG-24790 (KV-cache migration) as blockers for wave 2. Added dependencies.
2025-02-26 - Design review (Carmen). UX for the customer opt-in flow for scheduled upgrades reviewed; minor copy changes requested. See Google Drive design link.

2025-02-28 - Status update: calendar finalized for wave 1 and pilot; awaiting ENG signoff on blockers referenced in dependencies. Security review required before gating is closed. Next: runbook dry-run with Support on 2025-03-05.
